parity_receipts.scope: Full/QR PLE on the Sprint backbone; inspect pytest exit status for exceptions or unrecorded failures.
Full/QR PLE on the Sprint backbone; inspect pytest exit status for exceptions or unrecorded failures.

recorded_receipt.evidence: Observed pytest result from the completed CPU test invocation; tests were not rerun to produce this receipt.
recorded_receipt.source_hash_timing: Computed when this receipt was written; model and CPU test files remained unchanged after the passing invocation.
scope: Twelve actual meta-model shapes and exact unique parameter counts for Sprint/KDA with none/full/QR PLE and matched/additive budgets.
Tiny allocated CPU-model counts and dense nonzero finite refresh gradients.
QR prime/address layout parity with current SPALMER, shared index identity once per forward, and absence of stored per-call input/address tensors.
Independent full-table and QR lane formulas with repeated IDs and row collisions, including all parameter gradients.
Exact FP32 forward and gradient parity with current SPALMER QR-PLE.
Exact zero-gate forward/backward equivalence to the same initialized Sprint and KDA backbones; tied layer-zero embedding/head preserved.
Original none-arm classes and forward methods retained.
Causal prefixes, repeated-call behavior, BF16 residual dtype and FP32 parameter/gradient storage.
PLE/KDA custom initialization and rejection of unsupported inputs, variants and address contracts.

initial_test_issue.observed_error: RuntimeError: DNNL does not support bf16/f16 backward on the platform with avx2_vnni_2
initial_test_issue.resolution: CPU tests disable MKLDNN inside the BF16 residual/backward contract so ordinary CPU kernels execute it. No model source or CUDA/FLA path changed.
initial_test_issue.final_warnings: Four oneDNN/Intel-GPU TF32 availability warnings were emitted while entering the CPU-only backend flag context.

cpu_validation.scope: Previously observed pytest result; no raw stdout and no tests rerun by this generator.

qr_update_diagnostic.scope: Untimed diagnosis. Original tolerance/failing artifact unchanged. Scalar gate micro-contributions are differences of observed FP32 accumulated gradients; no hooks or model-source changes.
qr_update_diagnostic.interpretation: Small signed microbatch contributions cancel in the scalar gate; relative error of the final small sum amplifies BF16 rounding. Same-weight controls and integrated updates support a cancellation/rounding explanation, with no model-source change.

selection_policy: Prefer longer confirmations, then latest within the identical recipe; never maximize throughput. Keep every receipt.
comparison_policy: Compare PLE to no-PLE of the same architecture under identical non-PLE configuration, seed, input, runtime, warmup and measured-step controls and common source hashes. Equal-budget and additive experiments remain separate.
